topic: Design of a custom Claude-app-style mobile client for the pi coding agent driven by pi --mode rpc (JSONL protocol) exposed through a relay (Tailscale Serve or WebSocket bridge) to a mobile web app/PWA, with Claude-app UX parity: session list, chat bubbles, streaming, tool activity, approvals, push notifications.

focus: RPC protocol surface inventory + relay/transport architecture
noveltyJustification: First lineage pass; protocol inventory, missing list_sessions gap, framing pitfall, and Serve+WS topology are new to this packet.

ruledOut.approach: Use pi --print or --mode json as interactive mobile session protocol
ruledOut.reason: Print returns final message only; JSON is one-shot event dump without command/response control plane

focus: Claude-app UX parity + session model mapping
noveltyJustification: Session-list filesystem ownership, Claude→RPC action matrix, get_entries-first transcript strategy, and relay-level multi-device locking are new relative to iteration 1.

ruledOut.approach: Drive mobile chrome via TUI-only ExtensionUIContext hooks
ruledOut.reason: custom/setFooter/setHeader/setEditorComponent unsupported or no-op in RPC mode

focus: Streaming deltas, tool activity, and approval dialogs
noveltyJustification: Concrete bubble/tool-card/approval rendering contracts and agent_settled idle semantics go beyond iteration 1 event inventory.

ruledOut.approach: Render from cumulative message snapshots on each message_update
ruledOut.reason: Wire format is delta-only by design

focus: Push notifications, steering/abort/queue UX, and reconnect
noveltyJustification: Push bridge policy, steer/follow-up composer model, reconnect algorithm with entry cursors, and idempotent double-submit controls are new.

ruledOut.approach: Public Tailscale Funnel as MVP exposure
ruledOut.reason: Expands blast radius before auth model exists

ruledOut.approach: Silent auto-steer on Send while streaming
